passages.interview:
Date: May 11
Subject: Interview Date Confirmation

Dear Mr. Brandt,

We received your message on May 9th requesting that your interview be moved from May 15th to the following day. Your interview has been rescheduled for 2:00 P.M. that day, as you requested. You will be emailed a link to join the interview. Please open it 10 minutes before the start time.

Best,
Olivia Sweeney
passages.messages:
Elena Patel [9:15 A.M.]
Team, we need to finalize the presentation materials for next Tuesday's meeting. Let's make sure it is fully prepared and structured.

Sarah Kim [9:20 A.M.]
Got it! I'm working on the slides now. I'm focusing on the top three electric bicycles in our lineup.

Thomas Rivera [9:25 A.M.]
I'll include the rest in the handout materials I'm putting together. But I noticed some inconsistencies in the product specifications. Could someone please double-check those numbers?

Shawn Gibbs [9:30 A.M.]
You bet. I can verify those against the technical documentation later this morning, after I finish reviewing the budget report. I'm nearly done.

Elena Patel [9:35 A.M.]
Good catch, Thomas. Everyone, please carefully review your sections and make sure everything is accurate. The CEO will be sitting in on this presentation.

questions.prompt: When is the date of the interview?

options.label: A
options.text: May 9th

options.label: B
options.text: May 11th

options.label: C
options.text: May 15th

options.label: D
options.text: May 16th

questions.answer: The original date was May 15, and the interview moved to the following day. 正解：D、May 16thです。May 9thは依頼を送った日、May 11thはメールの日付、May 15thは変更前です。the following dayは「その翌日」です。

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about Mr. Brandt's interview?

options.label: A
options.text: It will be conducted via an online conferencing platform.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a follow-up meeting from a previously held interview.

options.label: C
options.text: It had to be rescheduled due to a problem at the company.

options.label: D
options.text: It is for a high-level management position.

questions.answer: A joining link will be emailed and should be opened before the interview, indicating an online meeting. 正解：A。Bの再面接、Cの会社側の問題、Dの管理職という情報はありません。conferencing platformは「オンライン会議システム」です。

options.label: A
options.text: Creating some slides

options.label: B
options.text: Preparing printed materials

options.label: C
options.text: Double-checking product specifications

options.label: D
options.text: Researching electric bicycles

questions.answer: Thomas says he is putting together the handout materials, which are printed materials for the meeting. 正解：B。AはSarah、CはThomasが他の人に依頼した作業、Dは誰の担当とも書かれていません。handoutは「会議などで配る印刷資料」です。

questions.prompt: What can be concluded about Shawn Gibbs?

options.label: A
options.text: He will need to finish slide preparation work by a deadline.

options.label: B
options.text: He will postpone reviewing the budget report.

options.label: C
options.text: He will not be free to do any extra work.

options.label: D
options.text: He will have time to take on an additional task.

questions.answer: Shawn is nearly finished with the budget report and agrees to verify the specifications later that morning. 正解：D。追加作業を引き受ける時間があると分かります。Aのスライド担当はSarah、Bは予算確認を先に終える予定、Cは発言と逆です。take onは「仕事を引き受ける」です。

questions.prompt: At 9:35 A.M., what does Elena Patel most likely mean when she writes, “The CEO will be sitting in on this presentation”?

options.label: A
options.text: She believes the CEO has concerns about the team's abilities.

options.label: B
options.text: She will not be leading the meeting herself.

options.label: C
options.text: She wants the team's work to meet high standards.

options.label: D
options.text: She is pointing out that the CEO will attend this presentation only.

questions.answer: Elena mentions the CEO immediately after asking everyone to review their sections for accuracy. 正解：C。重要な参加者が来るため高い完成度を求めています。A・Bは推測過剰、Dのonlyは本文にありません。sit in onは「会議などに同席・参加する」です。
